messages:
alex: heads up — support ticket P-1429. multiple customers reported 401s after pulling latest python/sdk clients. escalating because some are also seeing duplicate billing from retries.

maria: ugh. which client versions and when did they update? any repro steps from support?

alex: affected customers on python-client v0.12.0 and ts-sdk v1.3.5. support attached a quick repro: curl to /v1/generate returning 401, then client retries twice -> 200 but billed for 3 requests.

sneh: can you paste the curl and the client logs? also which regen/CI ran last night? deploy-bot showed an openapi push.

alex: here's the repro curl from customer:

```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-***" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-13b", "prompt":"hi"}'
```

response:

```
HTTP/2 401
content-type: application/json
{"error":"missing required header: X-Org-ID"}
```

then client log:

```
[2026-03-15T09:12:01Z] request failed 401, retrying (attempt=1)
[2026-03-15T09:12:01Z] request failed 401, retrying (attempt=2)
[2026-03-15T09:12:01Z] request succeeded 200
```

jen: that header wasn't in our public API docs. sounds like OpenAPI changed to require an org-scoped header and the regen job added it to server but SDKs weren't surfaced or documented.

kevin: checked CI: openapi-regenerator job #472 ran 03:05 UTC and merged a change that added `x-org-id` as required header on /v1/* paths. the regen bot created client PRs but they were auto-merged into a staging branch that isn't used by publish pipeline. so published packages didn't include the header param.

maria: so customers updated SDK (they installed the published package), but our docs/hosted API started requiring the header. mismatch -> 401s. then SDKs retried and support sees token-level billing for retries. :grimacing: 

support-bot: ticket P-1429 updated: customer reports rate-limit spike after retries; billing team flagged unusual token usage. request-id: rq_8f7c.

sneh: do we have a fast mitigation? we can either remove the required header on the hosted API (backwards-compatible) or push hotfix SDKs that default X-Org-ID from account metadata to avoid client-side 401s.

alex: support is asking for ETA to resolve. customers are impacted in production.

jen: immediate plan:
- rollback server-side header enforcement to optional within 30m (hot path)
- open a regen pipeline fix so generated clients actually publish (fix the auto-merge -> publish gap)
- cut hotfix SDK releases that populate X-Org-ID from existing auth token when available

kevin: I can revert enforcement. running a canary to 10% traffic first. also starting a PR to change regen workflow: created issue rg-191 to ensure publish step runs on auto-merged PRs.

maria: who takes SDK hotfixs? python + ts + go need tiny change: if X-Org-ID missing, read from /v1/whoami (or embed parsing from token). would prefer server-side fallback rather than fragile token parsing.

sneh: agree. server fallback safer and faster. if we make header optional and fallback to the account on the token, we unblock immediately and then push SDKs with better ergonomics.

alex: support replied: customers ok with short rollback. please include an explanation for billing team to reconcile duplicate charges.

support-bot: billing alert created BA-88. assigned to @finance (kevin looped).

jen: followups:
- kevin: do canary rollback & confirm 401 drop
- sneh: patch regen pipeline + ensure published artifacts for current openapi
- devex: draft a short support response template explaining why retries happened and how we're refunding duplicate token charges

kevin: canary started at 09:40 UTC. initial telemetry shows -95% 401s for the canary bucket. rolling to 100% now.

alex: thanks. I'll send support template. keep me posted.

jen: after rollback and regen fix, we'll also add a changelog entry noting the header change and a deprecation window before making it required. no surprises next time.

maria: adding labels: incident:minor, root-cause:openapi-ci-drift, action:regen-pipeline-fix

sneh: assigning tasks in Asana.

alex: closing the thread here once BA-88 and regen-pipeline PR merge. :white_check_mark:

kevin: PRs: revert-server-header-enforcement (#889) merged; regen-pipeline fix (#890) draft; will ping when published SDKs are out.

support-bot: ticket P-1429 updated: customers notified; refunds initiated for duplicated tokens.

alex: nice work team. please post final postmortem link when ready.
